title: Storm Burst of Repulsion Totem Hierophant
summary: Totems channel Storm Burst of Repulsion for you while you move: orbs jump outward and explode for damage that scales with their remaining Duration. The Hierophant adds an extra Totem right after the first Labyrinth.

title: Poison Summon Raging Spirits Necromancer
summary: You summon a cloud of flaming spirits that chase enemies down and, once you add poison, stack chaos damage on everything they touch. You run, cast and curse while the minions do the work, and the Necromancer makes them tougher and hit harder.

title: Tornado Shot Reliquarian
summary: You aim once and the arrow does the rest: Tornado Shot flies to the target spot, then bursts into more arrows, a Mirage Archer copies the shot, and the Reliquarian lets every arrow fork. You run fast the whole time, and by the endgame you hold one attack button and tap a blink to reposition.

title: Pyroclast Mine Saboteur
summary: You throw Pyroclast Mine: it explodes, rains fiery projectiles and puts a fire exposure aura on the pack. Automation and Detonate Mines set the mines off for you, so you throw, run and let the Saboteur do the rest.

title: Elemental Hit Deadeye
summary: A bow mapper: Elemental Hit of the Spectrum with Endless Munitions' extra projectiles and Mirage Archers clears screens of packs, while Artillery Ballista handles bosses. Levels with Rain of Arrows and needs no unique to work.
